'''Bohle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who lived in the mining town of [[Torbel]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The mother of [[Greti]], Bohle was a worker who suffered from [[damotite]] [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Bohle was present when [[Torbel]] was occupied by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After been forced to leave her job along with other miners, she suffered from [[damotite]] [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] and was afflicted with a terrible fever. When the village was visited by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Bohle was nearly close to dying from the poison, but her daughter was able to heal her with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After recovering from the illness, Bohle traveled to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] where she and the people of Lanteeb were offered sanctuary by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].
